1.

The work is finished, The blood of the Offering is poured out, And Christ now presents Our cause before His God; Our Priest, our precious Surety, Who can perfectly save us.

2.

Peace and forgiveness In His blood we have received. Our Minister, He pleads well for us. He, who endured the cross’s pain here, Now bears us upon His heart.

3.

No great earthly temple Is now His resting place, In heaven’s height He dwells, Our Priest forever there. All that in the law was shadow, Is fulfilled in Him, has passed away.

4.

He entered with His blood, The rent veil is forgiveness; We also may enter And worship Him there, Yes, in heaven itself We behold Jesus, the Saviour.

5.

Though for a time He is Hidden from man’s eye, Soon the world shall see That He has not forgotten His people. From heaven He shall come And gather all His saints.
